research_item_name: Domestic demand, wholesale and export split
source_title: May 2026 National Passenger Vehicle Market Analysis
evidence_excerpt: In May, domestic passenger-vehicle retail was 1.510 million units, down 22.1% year on year, while factory wholesale was 2.212 million units, down 4.6% year on year.
May passenger-vehicle exports, including complete vehicles and CKD, reached 0.784 million units, up 75.1% year on year and equal to 35% of manufacturer passenger-vehicle sales.

For 1-21 June, retail was 0.913 million units, down 23% year on year, while wholesale was 0.999 million units, down 14% year on year; year-to-date retail and wholesale were down 20% and 7% respectively.
scope_and_caliber: Mainland China passenger vehicles. Retail, factory wholesale, production and export are separate measures and must not be substituted for one another.
metric_value_and_unit: January-May industry inventory: down 0.350 million units
metric_type: Retail, manufacturer wholesale, production, export and inventory are reported as distinct flows.
comparison_period: May 2026 year-on-year comparison; 1-21 June 2026 year-on-year and year-to-date comparison.
contribution_or_rank_change: May export was 35% of manufacturer passenger-vehicle sales. Wholesale year-on-year performance exceeded retail by 17.5 percentage points, based on the same May source.
segment_definition: Domestic end-market demand is represented by retail; manufacturer outbound volume is represented by wholesale; overseas demand is represented by export including CKD.
structure_change: The reported May and June data show domestic retail pressure that is materially worse than wholesale pressure, while export is a major support to manufacturer volume.
representative_models: [uncertain] This item is market-level and does not contain model-level export or domestic retail records.
lifecycle_event: No model lifecycle event is asserted in this item.
overall_judgement: The current market signal is a domestic-demand and export split: factory shipment performance cannot be read as a proxy for domestic retail demand. May data show that export growth and inventory drawdown materially alter the wholesale picture while retail remains weak.
observed_fact: May retail declined 22.1% year on year versus a 4.6% decline in wholesale, while exports grew 75.1% and represented 35% of manufacturer passenger-vehicle sales. The June 1-21 scan retained a wide retail-versus-wholesale gap.
causal_mechanism: When export volume rises and inventory is reduced, manufacturer wholesale can look less negative than domestic retail. This is a flow-accounting explanation supported by the reported figures, not a brand-level causal attribution.
confidence_level: High for the separation of reported measures; medium for the aggregate interpretation; low for brand, region or channel causality.
alternative_explanations: Shipment timing, export delivery schedules, dealer ordering, seasonal working days and unobserved channel inventory by brand can change the gap between retail and wholesale.
competitive_set: Domestic retail competitors and export-oriented manufacturers must be assessed in separate scorecards.
competitive_advantage_or_barrier: Export capability can support factory utilisation, but it does not remove the need to win domestic retail, manage dealer inventory and sustain local transaction economics.
configuration_threshold: Not applicable at aggregate market level; configuration analysis requires model-level domestic and export data.
pricing_and_profit_signal: The source notes dealer operating pressure and inventory drawdown, but does not provide brand-level realised price or single-vehicle profit data.
target_user_segment: Domestic retail buyers and overseas customers are distinct demand populations and should not be aggregated in user-demand conclusions.
purchase_motivation_and_pain_points: [uncertain] Retail behaviour needs consumer and channel data; the observed retail decline alone does not identify buyer motivation.
purchase_barrier: Weak retail demand, dealer caution and discount expectations may constrain domestic conversion; this requires validation against internal leads, orders and inventory data.
channel_signal: Track retail, wholesale, dealer inventory, export and order cancellations separately by region, brand, powertrain and price band.
opportunity_or_risk_grade: A data-quality requirement: domestic demand and export must remain separate in every strategic market assessment.
recommended_action: Use domestic retail as the primary signal for China market-entry and product decisions; use export as a separate capacity and profitability scenario.
regional_capacity_or_channel_action: Do not allocate China regional capacity or dealer resources based on aggregate wholesale alone. Set separate domestic retail and export utilisation thresholds.
decision_condition_and_trigger: A domestic opportunity must show improving retail, inventory and conversion indicators. Export growth alone must not lift the domestic market grade.
next_verification: Join internal retail, wholesale, inventory, orders, cancellation and export data at monthly brand-model-region level; reconcile with the external association calendar.
data_quality_status: Passed for reported aggregate flows; incomplete for final June totals and brand/region decomposition.
data_gap_or_conflict: The June association scan covers 1-21 June only. Export data is not a replacement for China domestic retail, and model-level contribution is absent.
claim_boundary: This item supports the need to split domestic retail, wholesale and export. It does not establish that any specific brand's domestic weakness was caused by exports or inventory policy.
